real-nm-bone.label: Anterior and posterior views of a real whole-body Tc-99m bone scan from a dual-head gamma camera
real-nm-bone.cap: A real whole-body bone scan (Tc-99m, GE Millennium MG gamma camera): the anterior and posterior views are acquired together by two detector heads as the patient moves through, and each is a projection of the whole body onto one plane. Dark is high uptake. Data: TCIA CMB-PCA (CC BY 4.0).

views.label: Bone scan
views.facts: The matrix is 256 × 1024 pixels of 2.26 mm and the window of the Tc-99m photopeak is 126 to 154 keV. Each pixel holds a count of photons, at most 1015 here, so the statistical noise is large, and structures at different depths overlap in a projection. The posterior view is seen from behind, so it is the mirror image of the anterior view.
